adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the calendar update is performed via `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` using an `EventManager` constructed from the *caller* (`...user`) and `getUsersCredentials(ctx.user)` (line ~158). The handler already loads the booking’s organizer user including `credentials` (`include: { user: { include: { credentials: true }}}`), but those organizer credentials are never used. If a non-organizer (e.g., an attendee permitted by `isAttendee`, or a team admin/owner) invokes this mutation, the EventManager will not have the organizer’s calendar credentials, so updating the organizer’s calendar event referenced by `booking.references` is likely to fail or be skipped.
